datasheet.title: 1/4-Watt Standard Precision Metal Film Resistor

pinout.desc: Bilateral non-polarized terminal

datasheet.title: Aluminum Electrolytic Polarized Radial Capacitor
datasheet.package: Radial Can (6.3mm Dia × 11mm Height, 2.5mm Lead Pitch)

datasheet.appNotes: POLARIZED COMPONENT: strictly observe polarity. Reversing polarity causes rapid dielectric breakdown, gas generation, and relief vent activation. For AC signals, use non-polarized film or ceramic capacitors.

datasheet.title: Radial Lead Drum Core RF / Power Choke Inductor
datasheet.package: Radial Drum Core with Shrink-Tubing (8.7mm Dia × 12mm Height, 5mm Pitch)
datasheet.description: Ferrite core wire-wound radial choke offering high inductance, low DC resistance, and high saturation current. Widely applied in DC-DC converters, EMI filters, and resonant tank circuits.

pinout.name: Lead 1 (Terminal A)

pinout.name: Lead 2 (Terminal B)
pinout.desc: Bilateral non-polarized copper winding

datasheet.appNotes: Current through an inductor cannot change instantaneously (V = L·di/dt). When interrupting inductive branch current, use a flyback suppression diode or snubber to clamp inductive kickback spikes.

datasheet.title: 5mm High-Efficiency Red Solid State LED Lamp
datasheet.description: The High-Efficiency Red source color devices are made with Gallium Arsenide Phosphide on Gallium Phosphide Orange Light Emitting Diode. Ideal for status indicators, backlighting, and commercial electronics.

pinout.name: Anode (+)
pinout.desc: Long lead, positive terminal, connects to higher potential

pinout.name: Cathode (-)
pinout.desc: Shorter lead with flat rim notch on package body, connects to GND/negative

datasheet.appNotes: Always use a series current-limiting resistor to protect the diode from thermal runaway. Recommended formula: R_series = (V_supply - V_F) / I_target. For 9V supply and 20mA target: R = (9 - 2.0) / 0.02 = 350 Ω (use standard 330 Ω or 390 Ω).

datasheet.title: 1.0 Amp General Purpose Silicon Rectifier
datasheet.description: The 1N4007 is a high-voltage, general-purpose silicon rectifier diode designed for power rectification, reverse-polarity protection, inductive flyback clamping, and general commercial electronics.

pinout.name: Anode (+)
pinout.desc: Positive terminal, current enters here during forward conduction

pinout.name: Cathode (-)
pinout.desc: Marked by white silver band on package body, current exits here

datasheet.appNotes: Essential for inductive flyback clamping across relays and DC motors to suppress back-EMF spikes (V = -L di/dt). Place in reverse-parallel across inductive coil with cathode connected to positive rail.

datasheet.title: 500mW 5.1-Volt Silicon Planar Zener Diode
datasheet.package: DO-35 Hermetically Sealed Axial Glass Package
datasheet.description: The BZX55C5V1 is a precision 5.1V Zener diode engineered for voltage stabilization, rail regulation, ADC voltage clamping, and overvoltage surge suppression.

pinout.name: Anode (+)
pinout.desc: Connects to lower potential or Ground in reverse regulation mode

pinout.name: Cathode (-)
pinout.desc: Marked with black cathode band, connects to regulated voltage rail

datasheet.appNotes: Always place a current-limiting series resistor R_S between the unregulated input and the Zener cathode to keep diode dissipation within 500mW: R_S = (V_in - V_Z) / (I_Z + I_load).

datasheet.title: NPN High-Speed Switching & Amplifier Bipolar Transistor
datasheet.description: The 2N2222A is the industry-standard NPN silicon bipolar junction transistor designed for high-speed saturated switching, microcontroller GPIO load driving, and general audio/RF amplification.

pinout.name: Base (B)
pinout.desc: Input control pin (Pin 0, Left). 0.7V forward bias initiates collector-emitter conduction

pinout.name: Collector (C)
pinout.desc: Current sink pin (Pin 1, Top-Right). Connects to load to be switched

pinout.name: Emitter (E)
pinout.desc: Reference return pin (Pin 2, Bottom-Right). Typically connects to Ground (0V)

datasheet.appNotes: For MCU GPIO switching, always calculate Base resistor R_B = (V_GPIO - 0.7V) / I_B. Use forced beta rule (h_FE_sat = 10 to 20) to ensure deep saturation and minimize transistor heating.

datasheet.title: 500mA Fast-Acting Surface Mount & Resettable Circuit Protection Fuse
datasheet.description: The 0154.500DR is an engineered fast-acting overcurrent protection device designed to protect sensitive electronics, lithium battery packs, and embedded systems from dead shorts and catastrophic overcurrent faults.

pinout.name: Terminal 1

pinout.desc: Protected load output terminal

datasheet.appNotes: Mandatory for battery safety. When the fuse trips under a short-circuit condition, it opens into an infinite resistance state. In ElectroSim Pro, click "Reset / Replace Fuse" to restore continuity once the fault is cleared.

datasheet.title: Subminiature Sealed SPDT/SPST Toggle Switch

datasheet.appNotes: Low-voltage DC switching creates no sustained arc. For inductive or capacitive loads, derate current by 50% or incorporate a spark quench snubber to prevent contact pitting.

datasheet.title: Zero-Volt Universal Reference & Earth Ground Plane

datasheet.appNotes: Always connect at least one ground node in any circuit loop to fix the nodal matrix reference (V_0 = 0V) and prevent floating subnets.

Features 14 digital input/output pins (6 PWM outputs), 6 analog inputs, 16 MHz ceramic resonator, USB connection, power barrel jack, ICSP header, and reset button. datasheet.title: Calibrated Digital Temperature & Relative Humidity Sensor Module
datasheet.description: The DHT11 is a basic, low-cost digital temperature and humidity sensor. Utilizes a resistive-type humidity measurement component and an NTC temperature measurement component connected to an 8-bit microcontroller. Communicates over a single-wire bi-directional serial bus protocol transmitting 40-bit data packets.

pinout.name: VCC (Supply Rail)
pinout.desc: Power supply input (+3.3V to +5.5V DC)

pinout.name: DATA (Serial Single-Bus)
pinout.desc: Single-wire bidirectional serial bus. Requires 4.7k - 10kΩ pull-up resistor to VCC

pinout.name: GND (Ground)
pinout.desc: Power ground return

datasheet.appNotes: Single-bus transmission consists of an 18ms LOW start signal from MCU, followed by DHT response (80µs low, 80µs high), and 40 data bits: 16-bit RH integer/decimal, 16-bit Temp integer/decimal, and 8-bit Parity Checksum.

datasheet.title: Ultrasonic Sonar Non-Contact Distance Measuring Transducer
datasheet.description: The HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor provides 2cm to 400cm non-contact distance measurement with accuracy down to 3mm. Module incorporates dual piezoelectric ceramic transducers (40 kHz transmitter and receiver) along with receiver amplifier and threshold detector circuitry.

pinout.name: VCC (Supply Power)
pinout.desc: +5.0V DC regulated power input

pinout.name: TRIG (Trigger Input)
pinout.desc: 10µs TTL pulse input initiates 8-cycle 40kHz sonic burst

pinout.name: ECHO (Echo Output)
pinout.desc: TTL pulse output whose high duration equals sonic flight time (t = 2*d / v_sound)

pinout.name: GND (Ground)
pinout.desc: Common 0V ground connection

datasheet.appNotes: Distance formula: Distance (cm) = (Echo High Time in µs) / 58.0, or Distance (inch) = Time / 148.0. Maintain at least 60ms between trigger pulses to prevent measurement overlap from reflected secondary echoes.

datasheet.title: Pyroelectric Passive Infrared (PIR) Human Motion Sensor Module
datasheet.package: PCB with Faceted Polyethylene Fresnel Dome (32.0mm × 24.0mm)
datasheet.description: The HC-SR501 PIR sensor detects human and animal infrared motion within a 7-meter cone using a dual-element pyroelectric sensor and a BISS0001 micro-power PIR motion detector IC. Includes adjustable trimpots for sensitivity (distance) and output delay timing (0.3s - 5min).

pinout.name: VCC (Input Power)
pinout.desc: DC supply voltage (+4.5V to +12.0V DC, onboard 3.3V regulator)

pinout.name: OUT (Digital Output)
pinout.desc: 3.3V TTL active HIGH pulse when motion detected; 0V when standby

pinout.name: GND (System Ground)
pinout.desc: Ground reference return

datasheet.appNotes: The Fresnel lens splits the detection area into optical zones. When a warm body moves between zones, differential IR radiation triggers the BISS0001 band-pass filter and comparator. Avoid mounting directly facing heat vents or incandescent lights.

datasheet.title: Cadmium Sulfide (CdS) Photoresistor / Light-Dependent Resistor
datasheet.description: The GL5528 is a CdS photoconductive cell whose bulk semiconductor resistance decreases non-linearly with increasing incident ambient light illumination. Features wide spectral response peaking near 540nm, closely matching the human photopic eye response curve.

pinout.name: Terminal A (Pin 1)
pinout.desc: Symmetrical non-polarized photoconductive lead

pinout.name: Terminal B (Pin 2)
pinout.desc: Symmetrical non-polarized photoconductive lead

datasheet.appNotes: Ideal for voltage divider circuits: Connect LDR in series with a fixed 10kΩ resistor. Output voltage V_out = V_supply * (R_fixed / (R_ldr + R_fixed)). High voltage corresponds to high light level when fixed resistor is pulled down to GND.

datasheet.title: 5V Active Electromagnetic Piezoelectric Sounder & Buzzer
datasheet.package: 12mm Sealed Cylindrical Housing with Top Sound Port
datasheet.description: The TMB12A05 is an active electromagnetic acoustic indicator with built-in internal oscillator circuit. Produces a loud, penetrating 2400 Hz continuous sound tone when supplied with a constant DC voltage across its polarized terminals.

pinout.name: Positive Lead (+)
pinout.desc: Anode terminal with (+) mark on top of casing; connects to switched 5V rail

pinout.name: Negative Lead (-)
pinout.desc: Cathode terminal; connects to system ground (0V)

datasheet.appNotes: Active buzzers contain internal drive circuitry and sound continuously upon DC power application. Passive buzzers lack internal oscillators and require external AC/PWM wave signals. ElectroSim Pro utilizes Web Audio API synthesis to render real acoustic sound.

datasheet.title: 9g Precision Micro Position Servo Motor with Feedback Potentiometer
datasheet.description: The TowerPro SG90 is the global hobby and robotics standard 9-gram analog micro servo motor. Delivers 1.8 kg·cm stall torque with 180° rotation capability. Includes internal DC motor, gear reduction train, potentiometer feedback, and proportional-integral servo control amplifier circuit.

datasheet.appNotes: Position angle is controlled by the pulse duration: 1.0ms pulse corresponds to 0° (full left), 1.5ms pulse corresponds to 90° (neutral center), and 2.0ms pulse corresponds to 180° (full right). When powered from MCU, add a 100µF decoupling capacitor to suppress motor surge transients.

datasheet.title: 5V Single-Pole Double-Throw (SPDT) 10A Optocoupled Power Relay
datasheet.description: The SRD-05VDC-SL-C relay module provides safe galvanic electrical isolation between low-power microcontroller logic (Arduino/ESP32) and high-power AC or DC electrical loads up to 250VAC @ 10A. Built with an on-board PC817 optocoupler, flyback suppression diode, transistor driver, and switching indicator LED.
